official.application_route: Two separate online applications are required: first the AUC graduate admission application, then the dedicated Mastercard Foundation Scholars online application, which cannot be completed until an AUC ID number has been issued.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must currently be residing in an African country and in possession of citizenship of at least one African country
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is open to citizens of at least one African country who are currently residing in an African country; AUC's graduate admission also requires passport details from international applicants
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: AUC intends to award fellowships to 300 graduate students in fields that promote African economic development; applicants select up to two graduate programs in the AUC graduate application
official.duration: Awarded for the total study period of the degree, based on full-time enrollment, subject to review every semester for satisfactory academic performance
official.description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the American University in Cairo provides full scholarships and comprehensive support to talented young people from across Africa, enabling them to pursue higher education while developing their leadership potential and capacity to create positive impact. Scholars participate in leadership development activities, workshops and fieldwork experiences that equip them to become agents of meaningful change in their communities, countries and across the continent.
official.program_type: University graduate fellowship (Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program partner institution)
official.english_requirement: Minimum acceptable iBT TOEFL 79 total and 21 in writing, or Academic IELTS 6.5 total and 7 in writing, or Cambridge English Proficiency (CPE) or Cambridge English Advanced (CAE) 176 total and 185 in writing. AUC's recipient code for TOEFL test results is 0903. Results are valid for two years from the day of the exam and cannot be considered if the expiry date falls before your first day of registered classes. Unofficial results are acceptable for processing only. Some AUC graduate programs require higher scores, combining band scores from different tests is not possible, and possible exemptions from the English test may be allowed given specific conditions.

applicant_utility.summary: This is one of the few genuinely comprehensive graduate fellowships for African students, covering tuition, accommodation, a stipend, a laptop, health insurance, local transport and even roundtrip airfare if you are not already living in Egypt - but it is not automatic on admission. You must submit two separate applications: the AUC graduate application first, then the Mastercard Foundation Scholars application, and the second only becomes available five working days after your AUC ID number is issued. For the Spring 2027 cohort the window is 7 October to 2 November 2026, so if you have not already started the graduate application the clock is already running. Two conditions deserve attention before you commit: fellows are assigned 12 hours per week of related academic work on top of full-time study, and tuition is published as covering nine credits per semester, so any heavier credit load is on you.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Academically strong African citizens under 35 with a 3.2-plus GPA and demonstrated financial need who want a fully funded AUC graduate degree in Cairo and can carry 12 hours per week of academic work alongside full-time study.
application_readiness_checklist: Submit the AUC online graduate application at applyweb.com/auc first, because the fellowship application stays locked until an AUC ID number is issued
Diarise five working days after your AUC ID number arrives, then complete the Mastercard Foundation Scholars application at aucbanner.aucegypt.edu before 2 November 2026 for Spring 2027
Prepare a statement of purpose of about 500 words per program selected, and apply for no more than two graduate programs so both are properly argued
Ask two recommenders to submit their letters online directly - AUC only accepts online letters, and letters are valid for two consecutive semesters only from the date the recommender submits them
Book an English test early enough that results are still valid on your first day of classes, remembering AUC only accepts iBT TOEFL, academic IELTS or Cambridge CPE/CAE
Keep the fellowship deadlines page open alongside the graduate admissions deadlines, since the two schedules are not identical
common_rejection_risks: Completing only the AUC graduate application and never submitting the separate Mastercard Foundation Scholars application, since funding is not automatic on admission
Applying as a transfer student, who is explicitly not eligible for this fellowship
Falling below the 3.2 minimum GPA, or failing to evidence financial need convincingly
Being over 35 at the time of application, or not currently residing in an African country
Recommendation letters arriving late, because only online letters are accepted and it is the applicant's responsibility to track them
English test results that expire before the first day of registered classes, which AUC refuses to consider
Programs that require higher English cut-off scores than the general minimum, so check your specific program's threshold
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The published award is unusually complete - tuition for nine credits per semester, a stipend during fall and spring semesters, a laptop, student services and activities fees, medical service and health insurance fees, university accommodation, the AUC bus subscription or a travel allowance, and roundtrip airfare if you are not already residing in Egypt. The gaps are specific: credits beyond nine per semester are not named as covered, the stipend is only paid during the fall and spring semesters so summer living costs are yours, and airfare is not provided to fellows who already live in Egypt. Additional research, publication and conference funding is described as available to some candidates only, so do not budget for it.
document_audit: Proof of bachelor's degree completion must show official stamps and signatures, and originals are only required from those who are offered admission - but plan for that later request
Statement of purpose is about 500 words for each of the up to two programs you select, so budget writing time per program rather than one generic essay
Recommendations must be submitted electronically by the recommenders themselves; you cannot supply AUC with the letters directly
English results must be from an acceptable test - AUC will not accept the IELTS indicator, and combining band scores from different tests is not possible
International applicants must upload the information pages of their passport and one recent passport-size photograph
You may be asked to submit additional paperwork to be considered for the fellowship, so respond promptly to any AUC request
alerts: The Spring 2027 fellowship application window is 7 October to 2 November 2026, and the Fall 2027 cycles fall on 22 December 2026 to 17 January 2027 and 6 April to 6 May 2027
The fellowship application cannot be started until five working days after your AUC ID number is issued, so do not leave the graduate application to the last day
The Spring 2027 graduate admissions deadline of 1 October 2026 has already passed, so applications submitted now would be evaluated at the next graduate deadline
Tuition coverage is stated as nine credits per semester - check your program's standard credit load before assuming a full course each semester is covered
The airfare benefit applies only to fellows who do not already reside in Egypt
Final admission decisions should be expected within three to four months of the application submission deadline, so plan funding and visas around that timeline
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the AUC online graduate application, wait five working days for your AUC ID number, then complete the separate Mastercard Foundation Scholars online application by the fellowship cycle deadline; AUC and the programme may request additional paperwork, with queries directed to mastercardfdn@aucegypt.edu.
